people.name: Gehazi
people.line: Elisha's servant; punished with leprosy for greed and deceit.

people.name: Naaman
people.line: Aramean commander healed of leprosy by Elisha.

translations.web: So Gehazi followed after Naaman. When Naaman saw one running after him, he came down from the chariot to meet him, and said, “Is all well?”
translations.bsb: So Gehazi pursued Naaman. And when Naaman saw him running toward him, he got down from the chariot to meet him and asked, “Is everything all right?”
translations.kjv: So Gehazi followed after Naaman. And when Naaman saw him running after him, he lighted down from the chariot to meet him, and said, Is all well?
translations.asv: So Gehazi followed after Naaman. And when Naaman saw one running after him, he alighted from the chariot to meet him, and said, Is all well?
